Summary: On the AppWorld leaderboard, ACE matches the top-ranked production-level agent on the overall average and surpasses it on the harder test-challenge split, despite using a smaller open-source model. Specifically, on the latest AppWorld leaderboard (as of September 20, 2025), ACE matches the top-ranked IBM CUGA (powered by GPT-4.1) on average and surpasses it on the harder test-challenge split, using the smaller open-source model DeepSeek-V3.1. Notably, on average, ReAct + ACE (59.4%) matches the top-ranked IBM CUGA (60.3%), a production-level GPT-4.1–based agent, despite using the smaller open-source model DeepSeek-V3.1.
